title: 第11章 现在后悔还来得及吗第12章 新金刚丹大师姐就决定是你了
slug: 师弟你的丹药太不正经了
content_zh:
丹鼎峰，青云宗灵气最为浓郁的圣地之一。
主峰之上，云雾缭绕，仙鹤翩跹，空气中弥漫着沁人心脾的药香，只是呼吸一口，便觉神清气爽，修为都仿佛精进了几分。
李玄怀着几分忐忑与期待，踏上了通往峰顶的白玉石阶。
这还是他拜师之后，第一次真正踏足师尊的清修之地。
穿过一片紫竹林，一座古朴雅致的洞府映入眼帘。
洞府前没有华丽的装饰，只有几株叫不出名字的灵花异草在风中摇曳，散发着淡淡的光晕。
一道温润如玉的身影，正静立于洞府之前，仿佛已等候多时。
她身着一袭素雅的月白丹师袍，三千青丝如瀑般垂下，仅用一根古朴的木簪随意挽起。
她的容颜绝美，却不似冷月涵那般带着凛冽的寒意，反而温润如春水，眉眼间带着一丝悲天悯人的柔和。
特别是那双眸子，清澈而深邃，仿佛蕴含着天地至理，让人一看便心生宁静。
她只是静静地站在那里，周身便仿佛萦绕着一股万物复苏的气息。
仿佛天地，在为她的出现而喝彩。
她，正是丹鼎峰峰主，李玄的师尊，苏晚晴。
“徒儿，你来了。”
苏晚晴的声音轻柔温和，如春风拂面，让人不自觉地放松下来。
“弟子李玄，拜见师尊！”
李玄连忙上前，恭敬地行了一礼。
“不必多礼。”
苏晚晴微微一笑，上下打量着李玄，眼中露出一丝赞许：“不错，入门不过三月，便已是练气四层，根基扎实，灵力精纯，看来你这段时间修行很努力。”
她话锋一转，语气中带上了一丝歉意：“这三个月为师一直在闭关，倒是疏于对你的教导了。”

“今日出关，你在修行上，亦或是在炼丹上，有什么疑惑，尽管问吧。”
李玄心中一动，他正纳闷自己的金刚丹呢，这下机会可不就来了。
他直接取出了一个玉瓶，倒出一枚金灿灿的丹药，呈了上去。
“师尊，弟子在炼丹时，遇到了一些困惑。”
“这枚金刚丹，是我按照丹典炼制，但效果却……有些奇怪。”
“请师尊帮忙指正。”
身为丹鼎峰峰主，苏晚晴的炼丹之术，在整个青云宗，都能挤进前列。
如果连她也看不出其中异常。
那整个青云宗，恐怕就没人能看出来了。
也不知道这位师尊行不行。
“哦？”
苏晚晴接过丹药，打量了一眼李玄，似乎看出了他心中的疑惑。
content_en:
Danding Peak is one of the holy places with the strongest aura of Qingyun Sect.
Above the main peak, clouds and mist are lingering, cranes are flying, and the air is filled with the refreshing fragrance of medicine. Just taking a breath makes you feel refreshed, and your cultivation seems to have improved a bit.
With some anxiety and expectation, Li Xuan stepped onto the white jade stone steps leading to the peak.
This is the first time he has truly set foot in his master's place of cultivation since he became a disciple.
Passing through a purple bamboo forest, a simple and elegant cave mansion comes into view.
There are no gorgeous decorations in front of the cave, only a few unnamed spiritual flowers and plants swaying in the wind, emitting a faint halo.
A figure as gentle as jade stood quietly in front of the cave, as if it had been waiting for a long time.
She was dressed in a simple and elegant Yuebai Alchemist robe, with three thousand black hair hanging down like a waterfall, held up at will with only a simple wooden hairpin.
Her face was absolutely beautiful, but it was not as cold as Leng Yuehan's. Instead, it was as gentle as spring water, with a trace of compassion and softness between her eyebrows.
Especially those eyes, clear and deep, seem to contain the truth of heaven and earth, making people feel peaceful at the first sight.
She just stood there quietly, and there seemed to be an aura of resurrection of all things lingering around her.
It was as if heaven and earth were cheering for her appearance.
She is none other than the master of Danding Peak and Li Xuan's master, Su Wanqing.
"Disciple, you are here."
Su Wanqing's voice was soft and gentle, like the spring breeze blowing on the face, making people relax unconsciously.
"Disciple Li Xuan, pay your respects to Master!"
Li Xuan quickly stepped forward and bowed respectfully.
"No need to be polite."
Su Wanqing smiled slightly, looked Li Xuan up and down, and showed a hint of approval in her eyes: "Yes, you have only been in the training for three months, and you are already at the fourth level of Qi training. You have a solid foundation and pure spiritual power. It seems that you have been practicing very hard during this period."
She changed the subject, with a hint of apology in her tone: "I have been in seclusion for the past three months, but I have neglected to teach you."
"I'm out of seclusion today. If you have any questions about your practice or alchemy, just ask."
Li Xuan's heart moved. He was wondering about his Diamond Pill, and now the opportunity would come.
He directly took out a jade bottle, poured out a golden elixir, and presented it.
"Master, this disciple encountered some confusion when refining the elixir."
"I refined this diamond elixir according to the elixir code, but the effect is... a bit strange."
"Master, please help correct me."
As the master of the Alchemy Cauldron Peak, Su Wanqing's alchemy skills are at the forefront of the entire Qingyun Sect.
If even she couldn't see the abnormality.
I'm afraid no one in the entire Qingyun Sect can see it.
I don’t know if this master can do it.
"Oh?"
Su Wanqing took the elixir and looked at Li Xuan, seeming to see the doubts in his heart.
